description: Item goods option pipeline from gdevdb02

source.prepare_query: SELECT SYNC_ID, OPT_NO, OPERATION_TYPE, INS_DATE, INS_OPRT INTO #historytemp FROM itemsyncdb..s_goods_option WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE INS_DATE >= '2025-06-10'; CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX X_historytemp_01 ON #historytemp(OPT_NO);
source.query: SELECT goo.OPT_NO, goo.OPT_GD_NO, goo.INFO_TYPE, goo.DISP_TYPE, goo.OPT_NM, goo.OPT_VALUE, goo.SORT_ORDER, goo.OPT_PRICE, goo.INVENTORY_CNT, goo.VERSION_CHG_DT, goo.REG_ID, goo.REG_DT, goo.CHG_ID, goo.CHG_DT, goo.FTBL, goo.FKEY, goo.FTYPE, goo.CHANGED, goo.OPT_STAT, goo.OPT_NM_SORT_ORDER, goo.OPT_VALUE_2, goo.USE_YN, goo.REP_IMAGE_URL, goo.OPT_MASTER_SEQ, goo.SELLER_MANAGE_VALUE, goo.SKU_MATCHING_VER_NO, goo.ENG_OPT_NM, goo.ENG_OPT_VALUE, goo.ENG_OPT_VALUE_2, goo.SINGLE_OPT_SEQ, goo.STOCK_ID, ht.SYNC_ID, ht.OPT_NO AS S_OPT_NO, ht.OPERATION_TYPE, ht.INS_DATE, ht.INS_OPRT FROM #historytemp ht LEFT JOIN item..goods_option goo WITH (NOLOCK) ON ht.OPT_NO = goo.OPT_NO
SELECT * FROM bronze WHERE opt_gd_no IN (SELECT filter_value FROM baikald1xs.oss_gold.gemini_dev_filter WHERE filter_type = 'product_id' AND UPPER(use_yn) = 'Y')
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS ingest_dt FROM filtered
